exposure: Normal in utero development (newborn term pigs control)
outcome: Novel object recognition test performance (sensory pathway development, recognition memory)
cohort: Preterm pigs fed different formulas (PS-DHA or placebo) until term-equivalent age, with newborn term pigs serving as a control group for normal in utero neurodevelopment.
finding: Supplementing formula with PS-DHA increased brain weight, myelination, accelerated sensory pathway development and recognition memory, and was associated with higher survival in preterm pigs compared to placebo, with brain weights similar to newborn term pigs.
gest_age: Preterm (for intervention group) and term (for control group), specific gestational ages not mentioned.
